answer.message: Here are the relevant official guidance cards.

cards.title: Plan your post-study next step
cards.summary: The published Graduate visa guidance distinguishes applications made by 31 December 2026 (two years) from those made from 1 January 2027 (18 months). Doctoral qualifications have a three-year duration. This is general guidance, not a decision on your eligibility.
actions: Read the eligibility and application sections on GOV.UK.
Ask your university when it can report successful completion and discuss your own visa expiry with its international adviser.

answer.notice: General information and source navigation only. No individual immigration, legal or financial eligibility decisions. Do not enter passport numbers, account details or other sensitive information.
answer.handoff: For an individual decision, ask your university international student advice team. Quote the support reference if reporting a problem with this app.
